evidence_requirements.description: Resolve the issuer and its reporting currency and fiscal calendar.
evidence_requirements.fallback: State the identifier you assumed and that it is unverified.

evidence_requirements.description: Income statement, balance sheet and cash-flow lines for the latest period and the comparable prior period.
evidence_requirements.freshness: latest filed period as of research_clock
evidence_requirements.fallback: Use filed document text only; label figures non-standardized. For non-SEC issuers, acquire the periodic report found with issuer_documents and use extract_statements for statement rows.

evidence_requirements.description: Earnings release or MD&A: drivers, segment notes, guidance, accounting-policy notes.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Say primary text was not obtained; no memory-based figures. For issuers outside SEC coverage, list the issuer's own announcements and periodic reports with issuer_documents.

evidence_requirements.description: Prior-period and year-ago comparison computed deterministically.
evidence_requirements.acceptance: every change and margin comes from a calculation
evidence_requirements.fallback: Compute in the report; mark unaudited.

evidence_requirements.description: Price move around the release, versus a broad benchmark, if the question asks.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Omit; label any news price NOT market data.

evidence_requirements.description: Prior coverage and independent commentary on the results.
evidence_requirements.fallback: Note that commentary was not searched.

look_for: quality of cash conversion vs earnings
counter_evidence.if_none_found: List where you searched and say no contrary evidence was found there.

unit_and_period_checks: fiscal vs calendar period and quarter label
GAAP vs adjusted measures kept separate

reconciliation.note: must agree after unit normalization; explain any gap

stopping_conditions: statements and filing text for both periods obtained and calculations done
primary filing unobtainable after fallbacks: report the gap and stop

must_state: as-of date of each data series and the research clock
which figures are calculated vs quoted

limits: no consensus estimates in free sources: do not claim beat or miss; derive implied metrics (growth, margin change) and label them as inferred
